faq.title: Questions we get asked
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Send us a message and we'll reply the same day.
faq.q1: How long does a clean take?
faq.a1: A three-seat sofa takes roughly 45–60 minutes and a double mattress 30–40 minutes. We'll give you an exact time once we know what we're cleaning.
faq.q2: How long does it take to dry?
faq.a2: With decent ventilation, fabrics dry in 4–6 hours. You can usually sleep on your mattress the same night.
faq.q3: Are the products safe for children and pets?
faq.a3: Yes. We use eco-friendly, biodegradable detergents with no harsh smell. That's why we're happy to take on cot mattresses, prams and car seats.
faq.a4: Most of them come out completely. Old paint, ink or bleach marks may have permanently changed the fibre — we'll tell you honestly before we start, not after you've paid.
faq.q5: Do you come to my place?
faq.a5: Yes, we cover the whole of Cyprus. We bring all the equipment with us and only need a power socket and access to water.
faq.a6: Cash or bank transfer once the job is done. The price is agreed before we start, with no hidden charges.
